test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements best explains how mountain gorillas are contributing to the local economy of Rwanda?

options.text: Mountain gorillas are hunted for their meat and sold to the local markets, generating significant revenue.
Mountain gorillas are a major tourist attraction, generating significant revenue through ecotourism.
Rwanda exports mountain gorilla products such as ivory and hides, generating significant revenue.
Mountain gorillas are kept in captivity and rented out for scientific research, generating significant revenue.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct statement is "**Mountain gorillas are a major tourist attraction, generating significant revenue through ecotourism**."
 
• It highlights mountain gorillas as a major draw for tourists in Rwanda, thereby contributing significantly to the local economy.
 
• The revenue generated from gorilla tourism directly benefits local communities.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is "**Mountain gorillas are a major tourist attraction, generating significant revenue through ecotourism**".

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
